assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original character-review pixel-art turnaround for ELAINE VOSS, local city-alliance border/harbor affairs agent in low-magic medieval setting, NOT queen/national ruler. Reference ONLY for muted material palette, small top-down oblique game-character proportions and hard pixel cluster style, DO NOT copy male identity. FOUR well-spaced columns on uniform plain grey background: front neutral standing, back, side, then standing restrained palm-open explanation beside a small plain counter with CLOSED ledger and a disputed stamp RESTING UNUSED in separate tray. Same single adult woman in all panels: practical middle-aged appearance, dark hair pinned simply, weathered muted navy short mantle over brown wool robe, linen collar, plain leather belt and modest document satchel, ordinary boots. No lavish jewelry, crown, faction royal crest, plate armor, weapon or magic. Proposed appearance is noncanonical design, keep plain and believable. Posture cautious and responsible, not triumphant or smiling ruler; no act of signing/granting/compensating. Fourth panel's empty hand points to ledger boundary, never stamps or opens private pages. Silhouette first, compact 35–42-logical-pixel-like adult height in conceptual 64-pixel review cells, enlarged visibly chunky pixel clusters, minimal face pixels and cloth folds; no portrait microdetail, gradients or smooth illustration. Consistent body scale, bag and clothes across views. No text, labels, numbers, watermark. Concept poses only, not runtime-ready animation or certified exact pixel grid.
assets.qa: Four views retain navy mantle, brown robe, pinned dark hair and satchel. Closed ledger and stamp resting unused separate from explanatory open palm. Face/cloth remain denser and taller than requested logical 35–42px sprite scale; review appearance proposal only, no ruler/royal insignia or granted authority.
